title: Plan impact preview
source: lab/TARGETS.md section 6 row 11 and section 6.1 item 4; RULINGS Q38f
story: "Who gains work" for a candidate release over 100k subjects, without applying it, during live traffic.
checked: Identical answer to the post-activation sweep (GS.10) at one common input basis; never blocks writers.

witnesses.positive: subjects below $16.50 that gain work under R2's added rule (candidate list from the stream; O-DOMAIN confirms)
witnesses.negative: subjects at or above $16.50 (no new work)

domain: the preview of R2 at GS.10's R_act equals GS.10's sweep output at R_act (O-DOMAIN)

gaps: preview-equals-activation needs GS.10 and GS.11 on one world at one basis; same seed and subject ids are used for that reason

deliveryIdentity: RULINGS Q38f (main baeb9fd): work-item delivery identity is (id, publication sequence); the sequence increments whenever the payload to publish differs from the latest published payload for that id; publication state is persisted atomically with the outbox record; unacknowledged deliveries survive crashes and replay with their original identity; duplicate-visible-effect checks count by (id, publication sequence). A preview publishes nothing; its would-be deliveries are compared with GS.10 at the same basis.
rungNote: Sized for a shared 2-CPU dev slot (measured 2026-11-07: about 0.1 to 1 commits/s under pinned readers): the rung is the 10k-subject background world; the live phase runs the fixed trace (15 facts/s, open loop) with a scaled scenario overlay. Year-one volumes wait for PLAN section 8 order 6.
